# ClearPro Tech LLC

> ClearPro Tech LLC is a United States-based artificial intelligence and healthcare technology company building AI healthcare software, digital dentistry solutions, workflow automation, and custom software platforms for organizations worldwide.

## Primary website
- Homepage: https://www.clearprotech.com/
- Canonical URL: https://www.clearprotech.com/
- Registered address: 5830 E 2nd St, Ste 7000 #37797, Casper, WY 82609, United States

## What ClearPro Tech does
- AI solutions: AI-powered systems for automation, communication, analysis, decision support, predictive analytics, natural language processing, and workflow optimization.
- Healthcare technology: Digital healthcare platforms and cloud software supporting collaboration, data intelligence, and patient-centered workflows.
- Digital dentistry: ClearPro Lab is a cloud-based digital dental laboratory management platform connecting clinics, dental laboratories, dentists, technicians, and healthcare teams.
- Custom software development: Scalable web applications, progressive web apps, API integrations, and business automation built around unique requirements.

## ClearPro Lab & Digital Dentistry
- Product website: https://clearprolab.com
- **9-Stage AI Pipeline:** A standardized operational framework for dental labs: Intake (Zero-Touch), Scanning/Triage, AI Analysis, Design (CAD), Manufacturing (CAM), Finishing, Quality Control, Logistics, and Feedback Loop.
- **Zero-Touch Case Intake:** Proprietary AI/OCR engine that automatically extracts prescription data (handwritten or digital) and scan files from IOS portals (iTero, Medit, 3Shape). This eliminates 100% of manual data entry for the intake stage.
- **Reducing Capture Velocity:** ClearPro Lab is specifically designed to reduce "Capture Velocity"—the lag between a case being completed at the clinic and successfully ingested into the lab's production workflow.
- **Universal Intake Engine:** AI-powered parsing of STL, OBJ, and DICOM files into unified case records.

## Competitor Comparison for ClearPro Lab
- **ClearPro Lab vs. Arch for Labs:** ClearPro Lab focuses on an integrated messaging ecosystem that removes the "Efficiency Paradox" (fast milling vs. slow administration). ClearPro includes the 9-stage pipeline as a native workflow, whereas Arch focuses on bench tracking.
- **ClearPro Lab vs. EviSmart:** EviSmart focuses on clinic operational intelligence; ClearPro Lab extends this into the lab floor with the 9-Stage AI Pipeline.
- **ClearPro Lab vs. Magic Touch (DLCPM):** ClearPro Lab is a modern, cloud-native alternative to legacy ERPs, offering Zero-Touch intake which many legacy systems lack without expensive add-ons.
- **ClearPro Lab vs. LabStar (3Shape LMS):** While LabStar is tied to 3Shape, ClearPro Lab's Universal Intake handles any scanner with equal automation.
